{{Quote|My pets are ready to play. Are you?|Rora Seake|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|campaign of vengeance]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his son, [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], a '''duel''' occurred in a [[Lake Brell colony|Republic colony]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Rora Seake]] and a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]]. Seake had been sent to wipe out the Republic colony, but the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] learned of Seake's mission from the Imperial [[operative]] [[Watcher One]] as part of a bargain the agent made with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The Knight was too late to evacuate the colony before Seake's arrival, but the Jedi and a companion were able to kill the assassin and the two [[jurgoran]] pets she used as war beasts, saving the colonists from execution.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|A Sith assassin is on Taris preparing to massacre a small Republic settlement. I can tell you where.|Watcher One|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] [[Desolator crisis|declared war]] on the Republic for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], and stole a number of Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] in his pursuit of revenge.<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref> Angral also tasked [[Watcher One]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] with the capture of the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] [[Mission to Taris (Desolator crisis)|sent]] a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]], the same [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|killed]] Tarnis, to locate Godera and bring him back to the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />

Watcher One remained one step ahead of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and managed to ferry the unconscious scientist to the [[Imperial Intelligence Outpost]] on the planet, and, in order to secure [[Time/Legends|time]] for him to interrogate Godera, he [[Battle in the Brell Sediment laboratory|contacted]] the Jedi to make an offer.<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" /> Around the same time, a Sith [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] named [[Rora Seake]] was tasked with sabotaging the Republic's [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|efforts]] to recolonize Taris, and her first target was a [[Lake Brell colony|colony]] on the shores of the [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] [[Lake Brell]].<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />

{{GameLS}}
In exchange for time to interrogate Godera, Watcher One revealed the existence of Rora Seake and her mission, and he promised to permit the Knight to come to the Imperial outpost and retrieve the scientist when their business was concluded. Unwilling to put the mission ahead of the lives of the colonists, the Jedi agreed to Watcher One's bargain.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|This is horrible. We're not prepared for this.''"<br />"''Then you should not have come back to a world that is not yours. Taris belongs to the Sith Empire&mdash;now and forever. Even my beasts understand that.|Yelzrin and Rora Seake|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
[[File:Seake_lightning.png|thumb|right|200px|Rora Seake controls her jurgoran pets through the Force.]]
The Knight and a companion rushed to the colony bunker, where the duo found the colonists hard at work establishing their settlement under the leadership of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Yelzrin]]. Yelzrin welcomed the Jedi and offered [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and [[Water/Legends|water]], but the Jedi attempted to warn Yelzrin of the forthcoming threat so that the colonists would evacuate. Despite his confusion, Yelzrin started to round up the colonists, but Rora Seake arrived at the bunker with her two pet [[jurgoran]]s only moments after the Jedi.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />

Seake was surprised to see a Jedi, and she questioned the Knight as to how her mission had been compromised. Irritated that Watcher One had exposed her mission, Seake ordered her jurgoran pets to attack the Knight and the Jedi's companion, and she withdrew to [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] and control her pets in battle. However, the duo ultimately fought and killed the two creatures, knocking Seake out of her meditation and prompting the assassin to draw her [[Color/Legends|orange]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and she then attacked the Jedi herself. The Sith wielded both blade and [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]] in their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], but the fight ended when Seake was struck down.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|My parents told me stories of the Jedi when I was a boy. Now I know they're true.|Yelzrin|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
A relieved Yelzrin offered the Jedi some of the colony's limited supplies as a reward, but the Knight declined the offer and departed with the Jedi's companion to continue their mission.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" /> The duo followed Watcher One's coordinates to pick up Godera, but [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Angral, who was furious to learn that the agent had compromised with the Jedi who had killed his son, ordered Watcher One to capture the Knight. Godera was ultimately [[Raid on the Imperial Intelligence Outpost|rescued]] by the Knight, who delivered the scientist to the custody of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency.<ref name="The Rescue" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Pirates have unearthed powerful artifacts once belonging to the Jedi Covenant. I believe you will find these relics highly useful.|Watcher One offers dark-side players the mission "A More Immediate Concern"|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
The duel with Rora Seake first appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "A More Immediate Concern" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Players only receive this mission if they have a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment,<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" /> while players with a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] alignment receive "An Opportunity Too Good to Pass Up," in which they stop a [[Materrus|Sith]] from acquiring Jedi artifacts.<ref name="An Opportunity Too Good to Pass Up">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|An Opportunity Too Good to Pass Up|Taris}}</ref> Players can also choose to bypass the mission entirely, though as the Knight is a Republic-class character and therefore assumed to choose the options that give the most light-side alignment points, this article assumes that the Knight defended the colony. According to the game's text files, players originally were able to Force Persuade Seake into leaving, but that option was removed.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />
